tools.name: start-notification-stream
tools.description: Starts sending periodic notifications for testing resumability

tools.name: openproject-create-project
tools.description: Creates a new project in OpenProject

tools.name: openproject-create-task
tools.description: Creates a new task (work package) in an OpenProject project

tools.name: openproject-get-project
tools.description: Gets a specific project by its ID from OpenProject

tools.name: openproject-get-task
tools.description: Gets a specific task (work package) by its ID from OpenProject

tools.name: openproject-list-tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks (work packages) in OpenProject, optionally filtered by project ID

tools.name: openproject-update-project
tools.description: Updates an existing project in OpenProject. Only include fields to be changed.

tools.name: openproject-update-task
tools.description: Updates an existing task (work package) in OpenProject. Only include fields to be changed.

tools.name: openproject-delete-project
tools.description: Deletes a project from OpenProject. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: openproject-delete-task
tools.description: Deletes a task (work package) from OpenProject. This action is irreversible.
